runtimeCompatibility.assessment: Static engine-version match only. CommonJS utility worker import, actual Windows x64 load, decoder adapter, and packaged ASAR resolution have not been verified.

licenseNoticeFilenameScan.scope: Filename scan only; it does not establish that every bundled component or patent issue is covered by the top-level MIT license.

licenseAndDistribution.upstreamHeifNote: The upstream note describes the HEIF/HEIC decoder as experimental and opt-in while also shipping its code in the package. It flags HEVC/H.265 third-party patent due diligence as the distributor's responsibility; the package MIT declaration does not settle that question.
licenseAndDistribution.reviewStatus: OPEN: product/legal review must decide distribution treatment for shipped HEIF/HEVC and WASM assets and confirm applicable notices before dependency approval.

requiredBeforeAcceptance: Resolve the HEVC/H.265 distribution question and determine whether all packaged files/notices can be distributed for this product.
Only after that decision, authorize installation of exact version 0.17.0 and verify the selected JPEG/PNG registration path does not load optional HEIF or WASM code.
Verify CommonJS worker import, ASAR loading, exact full-frame RGBA adapter output, malformed input fail-closed behavior, and timely worker cancellation/retirement on Windows x64.
Repeat representative 16 MP PNG/JPEG measurements, including inputs near the 20 MiB cap and parent-process output transfer, against the 256 MiB worker RSS target.
